name: smwsprites-wario-dash
title: Wario Dash
description:
This sprite will give Mario the Wario Dash ability when he collects it.

While dashing (which replaces running), Mario's speed, pose, and colors change and he's invincible. He loses the ability if he gets hit or gets another powerup.

Because this sprite isn't a custom powerup, it requires UberASM to function. Check the readme for more information. Check the ASM files for customization options.
